name: vacuum_failsafe_age
description: Maximum transaction age (in XIDs) at which VACUUM is forced to run even if autovacuum is disabled or delayed, preventing transaction ID wraparound failure.
symptoms: Database shutdown due to XID exhaustion
Frequent 'database must be vacuumed within N transactions' errors

constraints.hard_rule: value <= max_val and value >= min_val and value < 2^31

tuning_tips: Keep near the default (1.6B) unless running very high-transaction workloads; lowering it increases VACUUM frequency but improves safety; raising it risks wraparound if autovacuum lags.
